high.title: Ibovespa Rally Doesn't Eliminate 'Invisible Risk': Empiricus Launches New Global Allocation Portfolio to Shield Portfolios
high.summary:
The Ibovespa continues its impressive rally, gaining 20% year-to-date and recently touching a new all-time high of 198,000 points despite ongoing geopolitical uncertainties. This surge is driven by several key factors: foreign capital inflows have resurged strongly with R$ 50 billion flowing into B3 in Q1 alone, expectations of Selic rate cuts ahead, and potential political changes that could sustain the market's performance throughout 2026.

While the current environment appears favorable for Brazilian equities, analysts warn of an "invisible risk" for investors going all-in on domestic assets. The strong performance has been supported by robust foreign investment appetite, suggesting renewed confidence in Brazilian markets. However, the concentration risk in domestic exposure amid global uncertainties has prompted portfolio managers to consider diversification strategies.

For BRL traders and bond investors, the combination of strong equity inflows, Selic cut expectations, and political optimism suggests continued BRL strength potential. The R$ 50 billion Q1 inflow represents significant demand for Brazilian assets, supporting both currency and fixed income markets. Watch for any shifts in foreign sentiment or changes to rate cut expectations that could reverse this trend.

medium.title: Small Cap Grendene Will Pay R$ 83.1 Million in Dividends and Interest on Equity
medium.summary: Small cap Grendene (GRND3) approved distribution of R$ 83.1 million in shareholder payments, with R$ 82 million as interest on equity (JCP) and R$ 1.13 million as dividends. The distribution reflects healthy cash flows among Brazilian small caps and supports the broader equity market's dividend yield attractiveness. This contributes to the overall appeal of Brazilian equities for yield-seeking foreign investors, supporting capital inflows.
